Keep in Touch

### Every client feels like your only client.

A client mentions their daughter is starting college in the fall. Levitate saves it as a key fact, and when move-in week arrives, it suggests a check-in and drafts the message in your voice. You add a personal line, send it, and the relationship gets a little stronger.

[See It in Action](https://www.levitate.ai/features/keep-in-touch)

RMRachel MorganClient since 2019

Key fact saved

Meeting Prep

### Walk into every meeting already caught up.

Before your day starts, Meeting Prep briefs you on each meeting and who'll be in the room: what you talked about last, what's changed since, and what's worth bringing up. No more digging through notes ten minutes before a call.

[See It in Action](https://www.levitate.ai/features/exec-assistants)

## Our people make our AI better.

With AI, Levitate can now handle the kind of work most small businesses could never afford to hire someone for: remembering every client detail, following up at the right moment, and keeping your marketing running week after week. But software alone doesn't know your business. Every customer gets a Success Specialist who learns your goals, shapes your content, and fine-tunes how Levitate works for you, with award-winning support whenever you need it. And when a business needs something of its own, our AI Solutions team builds it.

- A Success Specialist who knows your business
- Content made for your clients and your industry
- Award-winning support from real people
